scope: current original script documentation and realm group exist; not CK3 runtime fixture acceptance

excerpts.text:
title = <localization key> | <dynamic description>

	### Picture
	# A picture to use for the decision.
	# In case that there are multiple the first one that fits the trigger will be the one selected.
	picture = {
		### Picture requirements
		# Receives the character scope to check if it's valid.
		# Empty triggers always pass on default so do not type a trigger if you want it to always succeed.
		trigger = <triggers>

		### Illustration to show
		#
		# Path to the texture
		#
		reference = <file path>

		### Sound effect
		#
		# Name of the sound effect played when showing the decision details
		#

### Decision group
	#
	# Foldable decision group type to put this decision in. Default or not specified will select 'decisions'
	#
	decision_group_type = <key>

	### Visibility in decisions panel
	#
	# Can be used to hide decisions from the decisions view.
	# Mainly intended for decisions that show up somewhere else

### Relevant advice?
			#
			# Is this at all relevant advice for the provided title?
			# (Note: Renamed to is_valid_for_title in the advice database)
			#
			is_valid = <triggers>

			### Already doing it?
			#
			# Is the player currently doing what this advice recommends with the provided title?
			#

### AI reevaluation interval
	#
	# How many months to go between each check of this decision.
	# Has to be set (or 'ai_check_interval_by_tier'), except if ai_goal = yes is set.
	# An interval of 0 means the AI will never check this decision.
	#
	ai_check_interval = <integer>


	### AI reevaluation by tier
	#
	# How often should the ai check this decision by tier of top title (in months).

#
	# Override tooltip when selecting the decision from the decision list.,
	# 
	# Default: "<description key>_tooltip"
	#
	selection_tooltip = <localization key> | <dynamic description>

	### Override description
	#
	# Default: "<description key>_desc"
	#

#
	# Override text on the button that confirms the decision.
	#
	# Default: "<description key>_confirm"
	#
	confirm_text = <localization key> | <dynamic description>

	### Who *might* take this decision?
	#
	# Check if this decision should even be presented as an option for a character.
	#

#  - root (Character) ruler to check this for
	#  - scope:puppeteer (Character) ruler that might be initiating the decision through root as puppet.
	#
	# Default: Yes
	#
	is_shown = <triggers>

	### Who *could* actually take this decision?
	#
	# Check if this a character can actual take this decision; all requirements are listed.
	# Decision taken is also limited by 'is_valid_showing_failures_only', and 'cost'.

should_create_alert = {			# Should this decision have an alert made for it, applied on top of the usual requirements that the decision will be alerted for
		...
	}

	effect = { ... }				# effect to execute when decision is taken; scope: character

	ai_potential = { ... }			# trigger whether the AI should look at it or not
	ai_will_do = { ... }			# Returns the % chance of executing the decision. 0 will never execute it, 100 will always execute it. Will also determine the default option (if the decision has those) for players .

	# Specify up to one custom widget to embed in the decision. See section about Custom Widgets below.
	widget = {
		# Name of the widget to use. Must be at the path <decision_view_widgets>/<widget_name>.gui
		gui = "<widget_name>"
